label: Inside the Barrow
literalRoomDescription: You are inside an ancient barrow hidden deep within a dark forest. The barrow opens into a narrow tunnel at its southern end. You can see a faint glow at the far end.
safeSceneProfile: Ancient enclosed barrow of faceted earth and cool stone, matching the approved concept image. A narrow southern tunnel recedes toward a faint distant glow. Keep one sword and one unlit brass lantern distinct on the ground; no visible forest, sky, extra treasure or invented inscriptions. The shut entrance behind the viewer is a blocked source OUT attempt, not another traversable tunnel. Dimensions and placement are art estimates. Leave central floor slots free for dropped objects.

visibleInitialObjects.label: lamp
sourceText: A strangely familiar brass lantern is lying on the ground.
visibleInitialObjects.appearanceBrief: Portable familiar brass lantern matching the approved visual guide, with clear body silhouette and handle. The starting lantern is OFF. Emissive glass, light and flicker are activated only from observed engine ONBIT state; no permanently baked warm light. The idle clip must be unlit.

visibleInitialObjects.label: elvish sword
sourceText: An Elvish sword of great antiquity is here.
A sword of Elvish workmanship is on the ground.
visibleInitialObjects.appearanceBrief: Slender ancient Elvish sword, matching the approved barrow guide: steel blade, restrained brass hilt and dark leather grip. Preserve a recognisable hand-held silhouette. No invented runes, magical glow or hidden clues. Rest pivot and interaction bounds must support lying on the ground; action clips are presentation only. Model its resting geometry flat along +X with the broad blade face upward (+Y); the bounds describe that resting orientation. The resting mesh must not stand vertically at the ground anchor. Current draft requires only the flat idle pose. Do not infer a successful swing from an attempted action; action-result animation requires a later reviewed event binding.

view.message: You may not recall, but when you entered, the door of the barrow shut behind you. There is no way out.
